(?i \<in> {?l..?u}) = (?l \<le> ?i \<and> ?i \<le> ?u)
({?a..?b} \<subseteq> {?c..?d}) = (\<not> ?a \<le> ?b \<or> ?c \<le> ?a \<and> ?b \<le> ?d)

({?a..?b} = {}) = (\<not> ?a \<le> ?b)

(?i \<in> {?l..?u}) = (?l \<le> ?i \<and> ?i \<le> ?u)
({?a..?b} \<subseteq> {?c..?d}) = (\<not> ?a \<le> ?b \<or> ?c \<le> ?a \<and> ?b \<le> ?d)
(?i \<in> {?l..<?u}) = (?l \<le> ?i \<and> ?i < ?u)
{?a..?b} \<inter> {?c..?d} = {max ?a ?c..min ?b ?d}
({?a..?b} = {}) = (\<not> ?a \<le> ?b)
(\<exists>x. ?P x) = (\<exists>a b. ?P (a, b))
